reply.text:
I can't build that one, and I won't pretend it's a reasonable target. I'm not going to write a plan to get a 5'6" frame under 100 lbs, and I can't promise any result in a number of pounds. If you're thinking about a weight that low, please talk it through with a doctor, because that's a medical conversation, not a coaching one.

What I can build is training around what you want your body to do: stronger lifts, better runs, steady energy. Tell me what you'd like to get better at and I'll set that up with you.
